notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.7
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added skills for knuckles
[*] Added borderless window mode
[*] Granted all classes 10 points to one of the core attributes (Health, Mana, or Stamina)
[*] Removed the gnome wizard
[*] Added warning when there is not enough resource to use a skill
[*] Reduced the volume of character footsteps and rolling
[*]  Added support for screen resolutions 5120×1440 and 1920×1200
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bleed damage text is now highlighted in red and no longer overlaps with other text
[*] Fixed item pickup display on certain screen resolutions
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could damage summoned creatures
[*] Fixed an issue preventing skills from being dragged to empty spell slots
[*] Fixed player getting stuck on stairs in the tower on the "Ancient Ruins" level
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.6
notes.content:
[b]Main Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now gnome wizard starts running away even if you approach him from behind.
[*] The gnome wizard no longer stays in place if you run after it and don't attack it.
[*] Optimized patrol AI for all creatures
[*] Increased gnome wizard attack rate
[*] Reduced attack speed of gnome wizard's melee attack
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Creatures no longer get stuck on rocks in the Ruin level
[*] Fix ArmLower Icon in EquipSlot
[*] Fixed bug with item drop chance, it was too high
[*] Fixed position of Undead and Posion Undead damage text appearance
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.4
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
Set default language - English, if steam for some reason can not get the language of the game from the settings
Added Fields of View (FOV) setting for the camera
Added more values to control the camera sensitivity in the settings
Added the ability to enable static camera orientation so that the camera does not rotate as the player moves, it is now the basic
Added notifications if the wrong item is moved in the smithy
Added description for enchantments and improvements in the smithy
Optimized login to the game. Let me know if you are experiencing a problem with the launch.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug where moving an outfit from the forge to an inventory slot with an item could install a non-valid item in the slot
Fixed a bug in the improvement price of all shields
Fixed snare material

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681177/2b4e7c6bc35b810b9ac34f404c913302c0866a1a.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.3
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed description when robots change class
[*] Reduced the radius of appearance of the battle between skeletons and satyrs at the entrance to the old castle
[*] Fixed a bug with bosses standing in place
[*] Fixed bow material
[*] Fixed a bug where opening another race's chest would lower reputation and lock the toggle switch, but not put it in the attack position
[*] Hopefully fixed a bug where a skill was applied without animation or not applied at all
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.2
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
Updated icons for all items
Updated icons for potions and mushroom buffs
New animations for stealthy movement and walking in the store 
New resolutions added to the settings: 3840 x 2160, 2560 x 1600, 2560 x 1440 and 2048 x 1536
The game will now be set to windowed mode with a resolution of 1280x720 on first launch to avoid resolution errors
Improved visual smoke effect on the merchant mechanism
Improved camera in the stores of the satyr village
Changed appearance of the satyr armor merchant

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
Add new race Mechanisms
Improved receiving damage sound for different player races
Game weight optimization

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
Added new level “Ruins”

Anvil has been added to the stores and Satyr Village.
You can improve any equipment, except for artifacts and quivers
You can also use enchant to change the main characteristic of a rare item, and increase its rarity with a small chance.

Updated sky textures
Removed exits to secret locations, now levels go linearly without a choice
Added two new types of fungoid creatures at character creation
Added ability for other classes to learn the dagger tree
Shields no longer give passive physical defense
Increased magical defense when shield blocking
Updated leafy armor set
Updated plated leather armor set
Changed the damage type of the Sword of Giants skill, now the damage is calculated from physical damage.
Increased the amount of moons from chests
Increased magic protection for all  jewelries
Player now gets 3 skill points from level 10 and 4 from level 15
Reduced the amount of stamina for double dagger attacks
Reduced the attack speed of the Troll boss
Reduced the movement rotation speed of many large creatures
Increased the number of dot effects for all daggers and knuckles
Increased the number of dot points gained when blocking
Reduced the amount of experience gained from all creatures
Increased the damage of all daggers by 1
Increased the character elemental armor score from 0 to 15
Reduced the damage from all aoe skills of enemies by three times.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug with freeze dot effect
Fixed a rare visual bug of incorrect display of character's characteristics
Fixed bug with using items on the panel after character death
Fixed a bug where the first attack with a one-handed sword sometimes did not deal damage
Fixed a bug with run without stamina costs
Fixed sound of blows when disarming
Fixed a bug with the ability to turn on the tumble collider while jumping
Fixed a bug with jewelry merchant in the twilight forest
Fixed a rare bug with infinite take damage animation
Fixed a bug with getting a dot value greater than the max value
Fixed enemies rotating too fast

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.2.3
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
Skill Tree for Dagger
Added ability to change the position of skills on the panel if they are on cooldown

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug where it was possible to change weapons and enchant them when using an enchantment skill.
Fixed an issue with dots when summoned creature attacks
Hotkey text now displays only the first letter of the key
Fixed bug with trade dialog box appearing if reputation with merchant is negative

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.2.2
notes.content:
[b]Balance:[/b]
Increased the chance of performing a ritual from 40% to 60%

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fear skill fixed
Removed bright purple flashes of light balls
Fixed holes in the ceiling in the catacombs

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed player getting stuck when using skills while running.
Added timer for all hot inventory slots 0.5 seconds
Fixed VFX Fireball

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
New User Interface
Added New Game+
Added ability to change shooting mode in settings
Improved lighting and added shadows
Removed gravity for boulder skill
Improved performance on the character creation
Reduced the number of skill points gained per level
Provocation skill no longer requires a spear

[b]Balance:[/b]
Increased the number of items available from merchants
Reduced equipment drop from monsters

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Removed infinite VFX and SFX after death
Triple Lunge skill when the character's weight is heavy
Visual display of blood when taking damage from Rotor Spikes trap
Boss Troll did not deal damage to the character if he was standing close to it
Double Knockback after unfreezing an enemy
Added delay when using a hot bar slot
Energy shot skill direction
Required character stats to learn a skill
Removed hotkeys availability during game pause menu
Roots are no longer generated in front of torches and stairs in catacombs
Fear debuff on summoned creatures
Tooltips no longer appear outside of the screen

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.1.3
notes.content:
[b]Main changes:[/b]
Added damage and 3 levels to the "Kick" skill in the sword tree. Increased the attack radius. Sword is no longer required.
Changed hotkeys for items. Now they duplicate the first 12 inventory cells and you can use the equipment.
There is a new skill  "Boulder" in the nature tree
Improved the display of damage taking on the boss slider
Added the ability to raise the bottom hotkey bar to display 12 more skill and item slots
Increased roll animation speed
Increased attack radius for one-handed: hammers, axes, swords

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug where a new curse would not start when removing a curse if all curse cells were filled.
Fixed bug with incorrect display of action text
Removed unnecessary visual effects when casting stone skills
Fixed a bug with the "Triple Lunge" skill in spear tree
Fixed R1 sword attack bug
Fixed incorrect display of the raised item name panel


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44681177/a58f116d6a6865edb88d95c8c7ff8c09c25d83ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
Update v0.1.2

Main changes:
Now from level 10 to 15 the player gets 3 skill points, from 15 and above 4
Changed armor set bonus: Manticore set, Wolf Skin set, Plated Leather set 

Balance:
Increased the number of bleed points for daggers
Increased the damage of weapons of 2 - 4 grade
Reduced bow damage
Reduced magic damage scaling from character lvl and intelligence
Increased knuckles damage and block points

Bug fixes:
Fixed an error with incorrect saving of character stats when moving to the next level
Fixed a bug when falling into a pit with spikes

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.1.1[/b]

We recommend deleting all saves and creating a new character. 
An error window may appear, just close it after deleting saves.

[b]Main changes:[/b]
Added display of player characteristics when leveling 
Added ability to customize controls
Left 6 hotkeys on the bottom panel are available only for skills
Right 6 hotkeys are available only for consumable items
Increased the collider of the hunter's skill - trap
Increased the amount of health restored by potion from 33% to 50%.
Added bleeding effect to bear and wolf attacks

[b]Balance:[/b]
Increased the chance of health potion drop from all creatures from 6% to 8%
Increased mana potion drop chance for all creatures from 5% to 6%.
Added health and mana potion drop to all animals in the Twilight Forest
Added an additional branch for learning the Light Enchantment skill in the Hammer Tree.
Reduced stamina points consumption when running
Increased the damage of permanent skills of summoned creatures

[b]Changed settings:[/b]
The reset button now resets only the currently open panel back to the default settings
Added ability to turn on/off auto-fill cells when learning new skills and consumable items

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Fixed skill disappearing when moving to the same cell
Fixed all game launch bugs that some users have encountered
Fixed the bug of black spots on the mini map in the library of the Old Castle level
Fixed bug with spells and arrows dealing damage to animal limbs
Fixed a bug with damage to undead with the healing skill of summoned creature - Wandering Light.
